STATEMENT OF MAIN TERMS OF EMPLOYMENT
This written statement is given under section 1 of the Employment Rights Act 1996.

BETWEEN:
(1) Copperleaf Digital Ltd (company number 15014501) whose registered office is at 58 Primrose Mews, London, W2 3GZ ("the Company"); and
(2) Manpreet Chauhan of 186 Primrose Place, Brighton BN1 1NZ ("you" or "the Employee").

Employee details
Staff no.:     CD5318
Date of birth: 1963-03-08
Mobile:        +44 (0)7700 900725
Start date:    2026-08-27

SECTION 1 - COMMENCEMENT AND PROBATION
1.1  Your employment will begin on 27th August 2026. No previous employment counts as part of your period of continuous employment.

SECTION 2 - JOB TITLE AND DUTIES
2.1	Your job title is Marketing Executive. A job description has been given to you but it does not form part of this contract.

2.2  You will work from our premises at Weavers Yard, Clarence Crescent, Warrington, WA5 9JN, with hybrid working of up to three days a week subject to business needs.

SECTION 3 - HOURS OF WORK
3.1	Your normal hours are 35 hours per week, Monday to Friday, between 9am and 5.30pm with an unpaid lunch break of 30 minutes.

3.2 Your working time will comply with the Working Time Regulations 1998. Overtime is paid at time and a half when authorised in advance.

SECTION 4 - PAY
4.1	Your salary is £60,250 per year, paid monthly in arrears on or around the 20th of each month by credit transfer.

4.2 Deductions will only be made where required by law or where you have agreed to them in writing.

4.3  Your salary will be reviewed each April. There is no obligation to increase it.

SECTION 5 - HOLIDAYS
5.1  You are entitled to 20 days' paid holiday each holiday year, plus the usual bank holidays in England and Wales. The holiday year runs from 1 January to 31 December.

5.2 You may carry forward up to five days of unused holiday into the next holiday year with your manager's approval.

SECTION 6 - SICKNESS ABSENCE
6.1	Statutory Sick Pay is payable in line with current rules. Company sick pay of 6 weeks at full pay applies after probation.

SECTION 7 - PENSION
7.1 You will be enrolled into the Smart Pension pension scheme. You may opt out within one month of enrolment.

SECTION 8 - NOTICE
8.1  After probation you must give us three months' written notice to end your employment. We will give you one week's notice for each complete year of service, with a minimum of four weeks.

SECTION 9 - COLLECTIVE AGREEMENTS
9.1  Your terms are not affected by any collective agreement.

SECTION 10 - RESTRICTIONS AFTER EMPLOYMENT
10.1	You must not, for 9 months after leaving, try to entice away any employee of the Company with whom you worked closely.

SECTION 11 - CONFIDENTIALITY AND DATA
11.1 You must not, during or after your employment, disclose any confidential information about the Company, its clients or suppliers.

11.2 We will process your personal data in line with the Data Protection Act 2018 and our privacy notice for employees.

SECTION 12 - DISCIPLINE AND GRIEVANCE
12.1 If you have a grievance you should raise it with your manager in writing. Our procedures follow the ACAS Code.

SECTION 13 - RIGHT TO WORK
This offer is conditional on you proving your right to work in the UK. We have seen your passport, number 551356904).

SIGNED by the Employer
______________________
Name: Maria Doherty-Gibbons
Position: Head of Finance
Date: 03/08/2026

EMPLOYEE ACCEPTANCE
..............................
Name: Manpreet Chauhan
Date: 18/08/2026
